subject: Solaire Health — discovery recap, bakeoff plan and open questions
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Isaac Turner <isaac@solairehealth.com>, Solaire Health Procurement <procurement@solairehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Solaire Health — discovery recap, bakeoff plan and open questions

Isaac — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Bursty inference costs across episodic clinical report generation (high peak token volumes).
- Latency variability during peak windows causing clinician UX complaints (95th pct spikes).
- Need for tighter audit trails and per-tenant data isolation for compliance reviews.

Primary goals you listed:
- 95th-pct latency under 600ms for the clinician summarization flow (avg request size ~1.2k tokens).
- Unit inference cost reduction target of ~30% vs current provider.
- SOC2-like evidence for MDS and audit logging before pilot kickoff.

Suggested bakeoff scope (short):
1) Performance: run a 2-hour simulated peak with your sample trace to measure latency P50/P95 and tail behavior.
2) Cost: run identical workload on our recommended quantized model config and compare per-token cost.
3) Reliability: exercise graceful degradation (fallback to smaller variants) and measure success rate.
4) Security/compliance: confirm audit log exports + KMS key usage for the pilot environment.

Open questions from our side:
- Can you share a 1-hour representative trace (tokenized) and an S3 or SFTP endpoint we can pull from?
- Is the pilot limited to a single tenant or multiple customer-tenants? That affects isolation test design.
- Which stakeholders need to be looped into the procurement/contract thread (legal, infosec contacts)?

Attachments: I’m attaching the bakeoff matrix template and the recording from today’s demo.

Proposed next steps:
- You: share trace + preferred transfer method by EOD Fri (30 Jul).
- Us: schedule an ops kickoff to provision a dedicated test pool for the run and provide a runbook.
- Target: run the controlled bakeoff the week of Aug 9th (flexible).

If that looks right, I’ll send a calendar invite for the ops kickoff and loop in our infra lead.

Thanks — Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0147

Thanks Karthik — great summary and appreciated the clear next steps. A few quick notes: 

- We’ll provide a 1-hour trace and a 10k-token sample set by Friday. I’ll share via a secure S3 bucket (we’ll send credentials to the procurement address).
- Pilot should be multi-tenant (3 internal customers) — we want to validate tenant isolation and cost allocation.
- Procurement / Legal contact: procurement@solairehealth.com (CC’d). Infosec: tasha.moreno@solairehealth.com (I’ll add separately if needed).

On compliance: attached is a short security Q&A you requested during the call — it’s high level but should give you visibility into what the evaluation team will expect.

We’re targeting the week of Aug 9th for the bakeoff as well. Please include expected test durations for each phase (perf/cost/reliability) in the runbook.

Cheers,
Isaac
Head of Product | Solaire Health
isaac@solairehealth.com

Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 11:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Solaire Health — discovery recap, bakeoff plan and open questions

Perfect — thanks for the details, Isaac. A few operational clarifications and what we’ll deliver before the run: 

Operational clarifications:
- Multi-tenant setup: we’ll provision tenant namespaces and generate per-tenant metrics. Please confirm the three tenant IDs (or we can use pseudo IDs if you prefer).
- Data transfer: S3 works. Please send temporary credentials to procurement@redwoodinference.com and we’ll pull the trace to our test environment.
- Expected test durations:
  * Perf run (1x full trace replay): ~2 hours (includes warm-up).
  * Cost run: same replay but with cost tooling enabled — adds ~30 minutes of post-processing.
  * Reliability/fallback: 1 hour with induced throttling scenarios.

What we’ll deliver ahead of the kickoff:
- A runbook with exact schedules, measurement scripts and success criteria.
- A pre-filled bakeoff matrix (attached) you can review.
- A short checklist for infosec (KMS config, log endpoints) so your team can sign off quickly.

Open items for your team to confirm by Friday: tenant IDs, S3 access window (we need at least 48 hours), and whether the audit logs must be stored in your account or ours during the test.

I’ll send a calendar invite for an ops kickoff on Aug 6th (30-minute alignment + credential handoff). If Aug 6th doesn’t work, propose an alternative.

Regards,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
